name: After § 65
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 65a. Recalls that under the current seven-year financial framework the EU and its Member States have provided over EUR 193 billion (including EUR 69 billion in military assistance) to Ukraine, and are about to provide the EUR 90 billion Ukraine support loan; condemns the fact that, based on the Commission’s plans for the post-2027 MFF, Ukraine would receive 20 % of the total resources of the seven-year budget, and the Commission has already validated Ukraine’s estimates for reconstruction, which amount to USD 800 billion for civilian needs and USD 700 billion for rearmament; whereas the Commission plans to provide a significant share of this effort; whereas such over-ambitious aid would create a long-lasting debt spiral for future generations and absorb a large part of the EU budget for decades to come;
